headline: SUNY Cortland finishes atop the SUNYAC
dek: SUNY Cortland won thirteen matches overall, more than any other program in the conference, while drawing three and losing four. Cortland went unbeaten in conference play and finished with 55 goals scored and 25 conceded across all matches before closing its season at William Smith.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring drops off sharply toward the bottom of the league: Fredonia's 56 goals alone outpace Morrisville, SUNY Cobleskill, SUNY Canton, and SUNY Delhi combined.

wire.line: Outside conference play, league programs won 35, drew thirteen, and lost 43, conceding 175 goals to 127 scored.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches past their dates carry no published result, and both involve Oswego: against St. John Fisher and Nazareth.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Sammy Fausti of SUNY Cobleskill made 139 saves across the season, finishing with a 0.799 save percentage.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Fredonia midfielder Gabby Irwin recorded fourteen assists alongside eight goals on 70 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: SUNY Canton conceded 68 goals across all matches, more than any other program in the conference, while scoring nine.

last_match.line: SUNY Cortland entered unbeaten in conference play and on the back of a win over Fredonia.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
